Meet Mozart ↓
01 / THE OPPORTUNITY

You did the work.
You should get paid.

A shipment arrives. An invoice goes out. Then a deduction appears. A shortage, a pricing discrepancy, a compliance charge. Somewhere between a retailer notice and a folder of documents, revenue gets left behind.

Recovering it takes evidence, attention, and time your team doesn’t have to spare.

We’re building Mozart to bring it all together.

Mozart turns deduction notices and supporting documents into clear, evidence-backed disputes. It helps your team understand what happened, what’s missing, and what to do next—with a human in control of the final decision.

02 / THE APPROACH

Less chasing.
More resolution.

From the first notice to the final outcome.
One clear path through every deduction.

01

Start with what you have.

Upload a deduction notice or forward an email. Bring your invoices, proof of delivery, and supporting documents. No retailer portal credentials needed to get started.

↓
02

Build the case.

Mozart organizes the evidence, flags what’s missing, and prepares a dispute packet. Every recommendation stays connected to the documents behind it.

≡
03

Review. Submit. Resolve.

Your team reviews the case and submits the dispute. Keep deadlines, confirmations, and outcomes together, so nothing disappears into a spreadsheet.

↗
